business_summary: China Water Affairs Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the water supply, environmental protection, and property businesses in the People's Republic of China. It operates through City Water Supply, Pipeline Direct Drinking Water Supply, Environmental Protection, Main Contractor Construction, and Property Development and Investment segments. The City Water Supply segment is involved in the provision of water supply operation and construction, installation and maintenance, and other services. Its Pipeline Direct Drinking Water Supply segment is involved in the provision of pipeline direct drinking water supply operations and construction, installation and maintenance services, and other services. The Environmental Protection segment engages in sewage treatment, drainage operations, construction services, solid and hazardous waste, environmental sanitation, and water environment management businesses. Its Main Contractor Construction segment is involved in the provision of municipal public construction services. The Property Development and Investment segment develops, sells, and invests in properties. It is also involved in construction and operation of water conservation and hydropower related projects; water supply infrastructure and drainage operation; sewage treatment; municipal public construction; construction and operations in urban water treatment businesses, water environment comprehensive remediation and rural water improvement; energy conservation and environmental protection; property development and investment; development and infrastructure of sightseeing area; and operates hotels. In addition, the company provides warehousing, storage, trading, and distribution of oil-related products. The company was formerly known as China Silver Dragon Group Limited and changed its name to China Water Affairs Group Limited in December 2004. China Water Affairs Group Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Water Affairs Group Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 물 공급, 환경 보호 및 부동산 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 도시 물 공급, 파이프라인 직접 식수 공급, 환경 보호, 주 계약자 건설, 부동산 개발 및 투자 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 도시 물 공급 부문은 물 공급 운영 및 건설, 설치 및 유지 관리, 기타 서비스 제공에 관여합니다. 파이프라인 직접 식수 공급 부문은 파이프라인 직접 식수 공급 운영, 건설, 설치 및 유지보수 서비스, 기타 서비스 제공에 관여합니다. 환경 보호 부문은 하수 처리, 배수 작업, 건설 서비스, 고형 및 유해 폐기물, 환경 위생, 수질 환경 관리 사업에 종사합니다. 주요 계약자 건설 부문은 지방자치단체 공공 건설 서비스 제공에 관여하고 있습니다. 부동산 개발 및 투자 부문은 부동산을 개발, 판매 및 투자합니다. 또한 워터콘 건설 및 운영에도 참여하고 있습니다.
